intro: Nigeria stretches from mangrove swamps and rainforest on the Atlantic coast to dry savanna near the Sahara.

chapters.title: Rivers and regions
text: The Niger and Benue rivers meet at Lokoja and flow to the Niger Delta, one of the largest wetlands in Africa. The Jos Plateau and Mambilla Plateau rise in the centre and east; Chappal Waddi is the highest point.
The north is savanna, and Lake Chad lies in the far north-east.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The south is hot and wet, the north hot and dry, with the harmattan wind blowing dust from the Sahara in winter.

keyTerms.meaning: A dry, dusty wind from the Sahara.
